meta.title: Lease Loop – catalogue
meta.description: Lease an e-bike, laptop or farm machine. When the lease ends, it gets a second life.

brand.tagline: Circular leasing for e-bikes, laptops and farm machines

apply.title: Apply for a lease
apply.intro: We ask only what this lease needs, one question at a time.
apply.quoteNotFound: This quote does not exist or has expired.
apply.chooseActor: Choose who you are in the header first, then come back to this page.
apply.error: The application could not be sent. Check your answers and try again.
apply.invalid: This answer is not in the right form.
apply.pruned: Your change means {count} earlier answer(s) no longer apply, so we removed them: {questions}
question.why.q_full_name: The contract is made in your name.
question.why.q_birth_date: You must be 18 or older to sign a lease.
question.why.q_email: Invoices and the contract are sent here.
question.why.q_country: We can lease only to residents of Finland, Sweden and Estonia.
question.why.q_employment: Helps us check the rent fits your budget.
question.why.q_monthly_income: Rent may be at most 30 % of net income for consumers.
question.why.q_business_id: Identifies the business that signs the contract.
question.why.q_company_name: Printed on the contract and invoices.
question.why.q_can_sign: Only an authorised signatory can make the contract binding.
question.why.q_signatory_email: We send the contract to them for signing.
question.why.q_vat_registered: Changes how we show prices: with or without VAT.
question.why.q_usage_purpose: Delivery use wears the bike faster and changes the end-of-term check.
question.why.q_farm_registry: Farm machines are leased to registered farms or contractors.
question.why.q_annual_revenue: Required for leases of 50,000 EUR or more.
question.why.q_beneficial_owners: Anti-money-laundering law requires us to know who owns the business.
question.why.q_pep: Required by anti-money-laundering law for leases of 10,000 EUR or more.
question.why.q_pep_details: A politically exposed person needs a manual check by a person, not a rule.
decision.title: Your application
decision.notFound: There is no application with this link.

passport.title: Passport
passport.intro: {make} {model}: every lease this item has had, and the CO₂ its later lives saved.
passport.pastLife: Before our records: the dates are not known, {months} months assumed
passport.noLives: No leases yet: this item is waiting for its first life.
passport.co2FirstLife: First life: no saving, the item was made for it
passport.co2Total: CO₂e saved by its later lives
passport.method: How we count: a later life avoids the CO₂ of making a new item ({footprint} kg) minus the {share} % refurbishment costs, spread over its {designLife}-month design life and counted for the months that life lasted. The first life saves nothing, and once the lives have used the whole design life, a further life saves nothing more: a worn-out item replaces no new one.
passport.noMoney: Money saved is not shown: the data pack has no money factor for it.

impact.intro: CO₂e saved so far by second and third lives
